sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Wiring the Vessel is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "It looks like you will have to return to the Icebreaker after all. The data from the nuclear power plant logbook was not sufficient. Our partners need real-time readings from the power unit, so I've purchased a special device from Mechanic for remote connection to the central control station. Before you install it, however, you must ensure that all equipment in the technical areas is functioning properly. Take tools with you and restore the circuit breakers that have been taken offline, then install this device in the control room. I have been informed that the damaged breakers are likely located in three areas. One is directly on the way to the engine room, near the locker rooms with coats. The second is directly beneath that section. The third is somewhere in the corridors running along the engine compartment. Once you have restored all breakers, return to the central control station. Install the device there and report back."

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text:
- Repair the equipment in the automation room leading to the engine room on Icebreaker
- Repair the equipment in the automation room under the engine room on Icebreaker
- Repair the equipment in the automation room near the storage room on Icebreaker
- Install the hacking device in the central control station room on Icebreaker
Note: The "Install" objective will appear after the "Repair" objectives are completed.

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +30,000 EXP
- 5,400 Dollars
  - 5,670 Dollars with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 6,210 Dollars with Intelligence Center Level 2
- Unlocks barter for S I C C organizational pouch at Peacekeeper LL1
"It seems Mechanic’s device is functioning properly. I hope you managed to avoid contact with the special unit I warned you about. My recommendation remains the same: if you want to survive, it would be best not to return to that site."

sections.heading: Guide
sections.text:
| Item name | Amount | Requirement | Find in raid | Notes |
| Toolset | 1 | Required | N/A | This item is used for repairing the equipment. When used, the item is not removed from the player's inventory. |
| Local network hacking device | 1 | Required | N/A | This item is placed in the central control station room. When placed, the item is removed from the player's inventory. |

This quest takes place on Icebreaker. You first have to repair 3 pieces of equipment in automation rooms with a Toolset and afterwards install a Local network hacking device in the central control station room.
